# Fig Performance

> Private one-on-one personal training gym in Placentia, California, for adults over 40 who want to lose fat, build muscle and get stronger. Coached by Daniel Figueroa ("Coach Dan"), an ACSM certified personal trainer and Precision Nutrition Level 1 certified nutrition coach. Progress is measured with InBody body-composition scans, and members get red light and vibration therapy for recovery.

- Address: 1284 E. Yorba Linda Blvd, Placentia, CA 92870
- Phone: (714) 396-7178
- Email: trainat@figperformance.com
- Staffed hours: Monday to Friday 5 AM to 8 PM, Saturday 5 AM to 12 PM, closed Sunday. Personal training is by appointment.
- Serves: Placentia, Yorba Linda, Brea, Fullerton, Anaheim Hills and Villa Park (Orange County, CA)
- Reviews: 75 reviews of Coach Dan in total: 5.0 on Google (25 reviews of Fig Performance), 5.0 on Yelp (38 reviews of Train With Dan, his coaching business) and 12 more five-star reviews from people Dan coached before opening Fig Performance
- Price: personal training is $90 a session, 3-month minimum, 20% off when paid in full for 3 months. The first consult is free. Book it online: https://calendly.com/trainwithcoachdan/free-consult-inbody-scan

- [In-home personal training](https://www.figperformance.com/in-home-personal-training): Coach Dan trains you one-on-one in your own home gym across North Orange County and nearby cities
- [InBody scan in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/inbody-scan-placentia): body-composition testing (body fat, muscle, visceral fat), free with a consult
- [Red light therapy in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/red-light-therapy-placentia): recovery service included with membership; cost, safety, near Fullerton and Yorba Linda
- [Vibration therapy in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/vibration-therapy-placentia): whole-body vibration included with membership; does it work, who should skip it

- [Personal training in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/personal-training-placentia): how one-on-one training works, client results, pricing, hours
- [Personal training cost in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/personal-training-cost-placentia): 2026 prices, what changes the price, how to compare trainers
- [Nutrition coaching in Placentia](https://www.figperformance.com/nutrition-coaching-placentia): included with personal training; more protein, set calories, a simple plan from foods you like, no obsessive tracking
- [Free consult + InBody scan](https://www.figperformance.com/free-consult-placentia): free, about an hour, no commitment

## Guides for adults over 40

- [Fitness after 40](https://www.figperformance.com/fitness-after-40): index of all guides
- [How to avoid holiday weight gain after 40](https://www.figperformance.com/how-to-avoid-holiday-weight-gain): aim to maintain, keep steps and two strength sessions a week, protein first, limit drinks, plus a 20-minute hotel workout
- [How to lose weight after 40](https://www.figperformance.com/how-to-lose-weight-after-40): Coach Dan's plan for busy professionals: daily steps, protein, lifting heavy enough, training twice a week, hormones, and body recomposition
- [Can you build muscle after 60?](https://www.figperformance.com/build-muscle-after-60): yes, with two client examples (Teresa, 60, first pull-up in about 3 months; Sam, 70, deadlifting 135 lb for reps) and the exact progression used
- [Why am I not losing weight?](https://www.figperformance.com/why-am-i-not-losing-weight): eight common reasons the scale won't move after 40, and what to do about each
- [Strength training for women over 40](https://www.figperformance.com/strength-training-for-women-over-40): how often to lift, what to do, how heavy, and a sample week
